correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all quantifiers and the exact setwise multiplication hypothesis. Every element of \(V\) factors into any integer number of factors; two-sided Cauchy estimates yield extensions to \(\Omega_{ma}\) for all positive integers \(m\), hence to \(\mathbb C^*\). Unique extension defines a linear map \(T:V\to\mathcal O(\Omega_{2a})\). The Fréchet closed graph theorem yields \(p_{b_1}(Tf)\le C p_{b_0}(f)\) for \(a<b_1<2a\) and some \(b_0<a\). Thus \(V\) is complete in the norm \(p_{b_0}\), whose unit ball is compact by Montel, forcing finite dimension. A finite separating Laurent-coordinate family and zero-constant Lagrange interpolation produce a basis of pairwise orthogonal idempotents, each with finite Laurent support and coefficients in \(\{0,1\}\). The converse is exact by coordinatewise roots; zero algebra and nonunital nonideal blocks are included. No computations or unverified lemmas are needed beyond standard named functional-analytic theorems.
